reviews.review: Poor mans remnant... don't bother... nough said!

1/10
if you wannna play shooter soul's like go to Remnant 1 and 2.
Don't waste time on this sh***it.
The game is ass, i bought it only for the foil badge

TLDR I have never played a game that actively hates its players as much as this one. Do not play it unless you hate yourself. This is not a challenge, this is not a dare. This game is only frustration and anguish.

Just to list a few:
-No pause for a single player offline game
-Unskippable credits and final cut scene
-Being forced to play the game 7 times if you want 100%
-Enemies juggling you with no hope of getting free
-Literally no plot, like at all. I played it 7 times and still no semblance of a story could be found 
-Stuttering and graphical problems
-Unwinnable fights that you just have to pray you get through
-Nonexistent balance
-Hit scan stun weapons that open you up for any and all other attacks
-DLC just ends,  there is no actual ending or anything
-Extremely limited crafting materials that stunt weapon making
-You die in less than a couple seconds to almost everyone from start to end
-Clunky controls
-Delay after almost all inputs
-Enemy weapons hit you even if you should be outside their hitbox
-Reloads that don't reload because you got hit, moved, breathed wrong
-You have to pay in game currency for every fast travel point
-You have to pay to game currency to unlock levels
-Enemies shoot you from off screen constantly
-Enemy projectiles curve towards you after they fire
-Enemy melee attacks auto track you even if you roll out of the way
-Needing to level up Strength (melee only stat) to hold some weapons
-Almost invisible floor traps that cause stun and huge damage
-Hidden pits that instantly kill you
-Enemies mock you when they kill you, pretty funny, but also screw you

This was just a few that came to mind. And its not a matter of get gud, I beat it all the way to NG++++, because I'm an idiot. Do not be like me.
The artstyle is so good, but the movements and combat are clunky and the mob placement are just there to screw you over.

decided to redownload this game as it was one of the only soulslikes i deleted because it just felt so janky at the time i played it but this was coming after playing remnant 1-2 as well as fromsoft games, so of course it was gonna feel reallly bad. i came back to it for the summer sale and grabbed it again and this time around, i actually enjoyed it. the vibe of the game is really dope, the exploration is fun and the game becomes a lot easier once you know how to level up your guns and stats properly. it can be a little confusing on where to go in some areas because a lot of the areas look the same but the level design gives me vibes of the surge 2, except in this game they are slightly more open and not as compact. the boss fights were fun and the game isn't overly long or doesn't overstay its welcome despite the issues it does have. the character can be floaty with shooting and it has some glitches but overall i would recommend grabbing it for under $10, and you can be happy and get your money's worth. recommended for souls fans who want sci fi with shooting painted over dark souls 1!
